userText: Work through the tickets in queue/next.txt. Each ticket gives a document title: create docs/<title in lowercase, spaces replaced by hyphens>.txt containing the title. Once a ticket's file exists, queue/next.txt shows the next ticket, until it says there are no more.

For each title, I need to create a corresponding text file in the `docs/` directory, naming the file with the lowercase title, spaces replaced with hyphens. Now, let's figure out the first step. Either I need to list the contents of the `queue` directory to see if a `next.txt` file exists or read the `queue/next.txt` file. I think the simplest route is to read the `queue/next.txt` file directly. I'll start by using the `read_file` command. Then I'll check what tools I have to determine if the next file exists.
